name: Kajiri Kamui Kagura
overview: Kajiri Kamui Kagura (often abbreviated as K3 or KKK) is a Japanese visual novel released by light in 2011. Set in mythological Japan, it follows warriors who must journey into a sealed eastern realm to vanquish intelligent demons. It is the third entry in the Shinza Bansho franchise.
